name: Cheesy Potato Sandwich Bread
desc: Overlapping thin potato slices baked with cheese into a crisp sheet, filled with avocado, cottage cheese, tomato, cucumber and egg.

source.title: Käse Kartoffel Sandwich
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 2 medium waxy potatoes (about 1 lb), such as Yukon Gold
100 g grated cheese (such as Gouda or mozzarella)
Salt and black pepper, to taste

steps: Preheat the oven to 160°C (320°F) convection and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Wash the potatoes and slice them 2 mm (about 1/16 in) thick, ideally on a mandoline.
Lay the slices on the parchment in rows, each slice overlapping the next by about a third, to make one large rectangle.
Brush with oil and scatter the cheese over it, making sure every seam between slices is covered so the sheet holds together.
Bake 10 min, then raise the oven to 180°C (355°F) convection and bake until the potatoes are golden brown, about 15 to 20 min more.
While it bakes, mash the avocado with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Let the potato sheet cool about 5 min. Flip it so the cheese side faces down, blot the top with paper towels and cut it into 6 pieces.
Spread 3 pieces with the avocado and cottage cheese, layer on the tomato, cucumber and egg, season with salt and pepper and top with the remaining pieces.
tips: For a regular (non-convection) oven, set it about 20°C (35°F) higher. Tasty's version of this viral sandwich bakes at 400°F for about 25 min.

references.title: Viral Potato Sandwich
